query: Play devil's advocate on our plan to open a second café location next spring — argue against it as hard as you can.
Run a pre-mortem on our product launch: it's 18 months from now and it flopped, why? Do the same for the option of not launching.
Throw some deliberately absurd provocations at our customer support process and see if anything useful falls out.
Red-team our decision to move the whole company to a four-day week.
poke holes in this fundraising strategy pls, be brutal
Give me de Bono style 'po' provocations for redesigning how our hospital discharges patients, then turn the good ones into real ideas.
Our planning meetings always agree way too fast. Be the troublemaker on our Q3 roadmap.
What's the most unreasonable thing we could do with our loyalty program? Then tell me if any of it could actually work.
Our new pricing launches next month. Imagine it failed badly — why? And how would sticking with the old pricing have failed?
Lateral thinking session on cutting food waste in our school cafeteria — reversals, exaggerations, random words, the works.
I'm about to sign a lease on a bigger warehouse. Tear the decision apart, and tear apart staying where we are too.
Stress-test the city's bike-lane proposal the way a hostile red team would, then tell me what would harden it.
My novel's plot feels too safe. Provoke me — what if the story ran backwards or the villain won in chapter one?
make some trouble with our hiring plan, i want the crazy options and how each one blows up
Before we commit to rewriting the app in Flutter, have someone argue the opposite and pre-mortem both paths.
List every assumption baked into how we run our sales process and tell me which ones are still actually valid.
Build a standard risk register for our ISO 27001 audit with likelihood and impact scores for each risk.
Are we even solving the right problem with our churn initiative? Reframe it as a few how-might-we statements.
Run a full think-different session on our nonprofit's fundraising, using whichever crazy-one roles fit best.
Rename the variable usr to user across the files in src/auth.
